name: birdsong-field
vibe: Flat storybook nature in 9:16 — deep forest green and warm bark brown on cream paper, with flapping flocks, perched birds, swaying trees and falling leaves drawn as bold flat shapes. Seven authored surfaces that read like pages of a picture book rather than slides. Heavy grotesque headlines over calm body copy. For nature, sustainability, wellbeing, education, outdoor and craft brands that want warmth and character instead of gloss.
